arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished full-body character concept illustration for Dear Human, a mature science-fiction character wiki and art review.
Input image 1: STYLE AND SHARED-UNIFORM REFERENCE ONLY, the already established heroine Lian. Create a DIFFERENT adult woman, not a costume edit of Lian and not a duplicate of her face or long black hairstyle.
Style/medium: match the reference's sophisticated realistic anime-influenced cinematic 3D-render illustration, believable adult facial anatomy, restrained eyes, realistic skin and hair, detailed layered black/gunmetal composite armor, matte fabric, worn leather and subtle aged-gold trim. This is an illustration, not a game screenshot or pixel art.
Shared world: enhanced biological female clone soldiers, not robots. Human adult proportions, no visible cybernetic limbs. Same armor manufacture, high collar, restrained wing-like gold details and shoulder cape family as the reference. Each role has its own practical armor layout. Grounded cartridge-fed firearms, no energy weapons.
Composition/framing: a single character alone, vertical portrait, entire body from head to boot soles and complete equipment visible with comfortable margins, calm three-quarter standing pose. Face clearly readable, beautiful polished character-key-art quality. Black charcoal studio backdrop with a faint cool atmospheric gradient, subtle floor contact shadow, no scene clutter. Soft broad key light, delicate cool rim separation, no dramatic colored skin tint. Weapons carried safely, no firing, no combat action.
Constraints: no text, no letters or invented official codes, no labels, no watermark, no collage, no second person, no helmet hiding the face, no gas mask, no giant breast proportions, no nudity, no gratuitous gore. Preserve the visual identity of this shared setting while making a distinct individual.

Subject: MOA, an unmistakably adult woman in her late twenties, the squad support gunner. Distinct gently square face, steady hazel-brown eyes, naturally light neutral skin, chestnut-auburn medium-long hair secured into a practical thick braid behind the shoulder. Strong athletic but realistically feminine build, broader shoulders than the reference without becoming a giant or bodybuilder.
Wardrobe and role: black/gunmetal segmented armor from the same uniform family, grey chest inset and restrained aged-gold trim, reinforced shoulders and forearms, structured armored waist panels with protective underlayers, tall armored boots. A short split shoulder mantle clears the weapon and ammunition equipment. Several coherent ammunition pouches at waist, substantial but not cluttered; no medical insignia or medical bags.
Equipment and pose: one realistic conventional belt-fed light machine gun, recognizable as a squad-support weapon by its box magazine/ammunition container, sturdy barrel and folded bipod, held securely with both hands across the body at a lowered diagonal. Weapon weight feels supported by her stance. No shooting, no floating ammo or absurdly huge barrels. The complete gun and both boots stay within frame. Expression: grounded, quietly reassuring, slight warmth in the eyes, not an exaggerated grin.
